meta.homeDescription: Help around the home in Split: small repairs, furniture made to fit or assembled, a look at a flat before you rent it, rides to the airport and nearby cities, and balloons for a party.

hero.title: Need help in Split?
hero.subtitle: Have a look at what we do now. The list grows as people ask for new things. If you don't see what you need, write to us and we'll do our best.
hero.noteBody: No call centre. If the job isn't clear, we ask before we come.

services.title: Services
services.missing: If what you need isn't on the list, tell us and we'll do our best to help.
services.empty: Nothing is listed right now. Write to us anyway and we'll tell you if we can help.

reviews.title: Coming soon
reviews.body: We're gathering the first reviews from people we've already helped. They'll show up here.
